window.PERSONALIZED_FEED_RPC_URL = "/rpc/block-contracts/daff82b9-f90a-4ce8-be34-9c6989520e41";
window.thirdparty.push({family: "business", name: "historique-liste-personnalisee",
  fn: function() {
    var NOTIF_PENDING_KEY = 'personalized-feed-notif-pending';
    var SYNC_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

    function hasPendingNotif() { return window.localStorage.getItem(NOTIF_PENDING_KEY) === '1'; }

    function showNotifBubbles() {
      for(const link of [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-personalized-feed-notif] .su-bubble')]) {
        link.classList.remove('su-hidden');
      }
    }
    const decodeName = s => {
      try { s = decodeURIComponent(s); } catch {}
      return s.replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, n) => String.fromCodePoint(Number(n)));
    };

    function syncServiceWorker() {if (hasPendingNotif()) {
        return showNotifBubbles();
      }
      if (!navigator.serviceWorker || !navigator.serviceWorker.controller || !window.PERSONALIZED_FEED_RPC_URL) return;
      var historique = window.localStorage.getItem('contentslist-scoring'); if (!historique) return;
        historique = JSON.parse(historique);

      for (const tags of historique.tags || []) {
        if (typeof tags.name === 'string') tags.name = decodeName(tags.name);
      }

      navigator.serviceWorker.controller.postMessage({
        type: 'PERSONALIZED_FEED_SYNC',
        rpcUrl: window.PERSONALIZED_FEED_RPC_URL,
        historique: historique,
      });
    }

    if (navigator.serviceWorker) {
      navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
        if (event.data && event.data.type === 'PERSONALIZED_FEED_NEW_ITEMS') {
          window.localStorage.setItem(NOTIF_PENDING_KEY, '1');
          showNotifBubbles();
        }
      });

      navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(function () {
        syncServiceWorker();
        window.addEventListener('focus', syncServiceWorker);setInterval(syncServiceWorker, SYNC_INTERVAL_MS);
      });
    }
  }
});
